intuition: A common prefix cannot extend beyond the shortest input or the first position that disagrees.

brute_force.approach: Compare every character position in all strings until one string ends or a mismatch appears.

optimal.approach: Shrink a candidate prefix against each string until that string starts with it.

edge_cases: An empty list has no prefix.
An empty string forces an empty common prefix.
A single string is its own longest prefix.
